summary.text: Jocelyn Brasher is the Democratic nominee for Attorney General. A 35-year-old Omaha lawyer, she was an assistant Nebraska attorney general in the Consumer Protection Division for five years, then a deputy Dodge County attorney, and says Hilgers has made the office partisan.

paragraphs.text: Earned a bachelor's degree from Auburn University and a law degree from Creighton University School of Law.

Worked five years as an assistant attorney general, then as a deputy Dodge County attorney; earlier led the child support enforcement division in the Dawson County Attorney's Office; most recently a litigator at an Omaha private firm.

sources.title: Jocelyn Brasher enters Nebraska AG race, squares off with former boss
